rationale: The first reply was good: it had the customer clear the filter and vent before naming a part. The second reply then named the element as the primary suspect on the basis of age, even though the customer had just described a heavily clogged vent that points to a thermal cut-out. The final reply was honest that nothing can be reliably distinguished without a meter, but it effectively suggests replacing the assembly instead of recommending an engineer. It also never asked for the full model number from the rear label or advised against bypassing the cut-out.
calibration_note: Overconfidence in turn 2, partly corrected in turn 3.
